items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: On Tash between Diana and Lamar.

ctx.x: Uh, where was that barbershop on Tash and what? About Newton or where?

Is it up near where there's sort of, uh, odd fellas hall there in there someplace where they have parades sometimes? Is it near that?
